name: Charles Goerens - § 1
title: REPORT on financing for development – ahead of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development in Seville
part_text: Stresses the importance for the international community to utilise the opportunities presented by the 4th Financing for Development Conference (FfD4) in Seville to promote structural reform of the international financial architecture to democratise international development cooperation and create equal power sharing, and to call for equitable and inclusive development cooperation policies that support gender equality;
